extDesc.message: Sends browser traffic into the EVA VPN tunnel. The desktop client is required: it holds the connection.

hintNoApp.message: Start EVA VPN — it holds the proxy

bypassNote.message: The browser opens these addresses directly even while the extension is on. Useful for banks and sites that object to a foreign address.

portsNote.message: Only change these if you changed the port in the desktop app.
